chunkymcchunkface.configuration.baseRang: The base range around the chunk loader that will be loaded (0 = 1 chunk only) [default: 0]
chunkymcchunkface.configuration.offlineT: The time in ticks that the chunk loader will stay loaded after all players that interacted with it have gone offline (168000 = 7 in-game days worth of time (140 minutes)) [default: 168000]
chunkymcchunkface.configuration.tier1Ran: The range of a tier 1 chunk loader (1 = 3x3) [default: 1]
chunkymcchunkface.configuration.tier2Ran: The range of a tier 2 chunk loader (2 = 5x5) [default: 2]
chunkymcchunkface.configuration.tier3Ran: The range of a tier 3 chunk loader (3 = 7x7) [default: 3]
chunkymcchunkface.configuration.tier4Ran: The range of a tier 4 chunk loader (4 = 9x9) [default: 4]
